title: Repo at 5.50%: The First Hike Since February 2023
subtitle: On 7 October 2026 the RBI MPC raised the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% and moved the stance to calibrated tightening. A composite consumer CFO must price a 15 October reset before the board sits on the 16th.
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 9 October 2026. Public facts from the RBI Monetary Policy Statement of 7 October 2026: unanimous +25 bps to 5.50% repo; SDF 5.25%; MSF and Bank Rate 5.75%; stance to calibrated tightening (Business Standard: 4-2). First hike since February 2023 after 125 bps of easing from 6.50% to 5.25%. FY27 GDP forecast raised to 7.1% from 6.7%; FY27 CPI to 5.2% from 5.0%; headline CPI expected to average almost 5.8% over the next three quarters; core 4.4%. Forex reserves $734.6 bn as of 2 October; net FDI $13.8 bn April-August; FPI outflows $10.3 bn; credit growth 18.1% (Mint) / 18-19% (Deputy Governor Swaminathan J). Composite firm: Malabar Consumer Products Ltd. Composite CFO: Meera Iyer.
thumbnail: REPO 5.50%. STANCE: CALIBRATED TIGHTENING. THE RESET IS 15 OCTOBER.
